docs.message:
docs(pdt42): core triangle with adopting adults as core entity (D4)

## Intent

Decide which relationships and which role the platform design starts from. Creators build personal software for their own class or child anyway. Adults depend on finding apps they can use without doubt, so that is where the platform makes the difference.

## Key changes

- A new D4 chapter sets three core relationships as a triangle: creators and adults, adults and students, creators and students. It explains why students are now in the core, unlike in the brief.
- The core entity is the adopting adults. The chapter and the platform block in D1 say why creators are not: they build without the platform, and use by others is a nice-to-have for them.
- The creators' portrait says the same about reach.
- The development plan marks D4 done and adds KD-13.

moved.why: The reason for the D4 core entity; i202 has no commits left.
